description: This file defines an abstract assertion class for Command objects used in testing. It provides methods to verify properties such as type, headers, resource path, and manifest within Command instances, leveraging AssertJ assertions.

classes.name: AbstractCommandAssert
classes.description: An abstract class providing assertion utilities for Command objects in tests, supporting fluent assertions on command properties.

methods.name: AbstractCommandAssert
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the assertion object with a specific Command instance and its self-referential type.

methods.name: withType
methods.description: Asserts that the Command's type matches the expected type.

methods.name: hasDittoHeaders
methods.description: Asserts that the Command contains the expected DittoHeaders.

methods.name: hasCorrelationId
methods.description: Asserts that the Command's correlation ID matches the expected value.

methods.name: withDittoHeaders
methods.description: Asserts that the Command's headers match the expected DittoHeaders.

methods.name: withResourcePath
methods.description: Asserts that the Command's resource path matches the expected JsonPointer.

methods.name: withManifest
methods.description: Asserts that the Command's manifest string matches the expected value.

methods.name: assertThatEquals
methods.description: Helper method that performs an equality assertion with a custom error message.
